lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance local maxima arranged in roughly five horizontal rows; a primary central cluster features six evenly spaced, roughly circular centroids (approx. 25-30px diameter) extending from the branchial region to the dorsal fin origin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (~15% increase vs background) intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a distinct 4x7 rectilinear grid of high-intensity nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features; the primary ridge runs from the posterior margin of the gills to the caudal peduncle, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 small, low-contrast high-luminance clusters (5-10px diameter) localized primarily within the anterior and basal regions of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, high-luminance foreign body or lesion visible at the distal-most tip of the pectoral fin; minor irregular indentation on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; small linear mark posterior to the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: A zone of high-density, heterogeneous small-diameter spots (3-5px) located immediately posterior to the fifth branchial slit, preceding the transition into the standardized lateral grid.
